old_problem: Correctable criteria conflict with IOD UCE intent, link0/errorlocation0-to-IOD mapping and errortype1 are unproven, and no deterministic containment/reset or endpoint-specific recovery oracle exists.
disposition_reason: Runtime enumeration can supply a numeric link only after vendor topology defines its endpoint and errorlocation perspective. The severity contradiction and proprietary flag determine PASS and reset/recovery, so they cannot be parameterized away. ED-03/12/15/16 prohibit guessing. Pending/BLOCKED remains.

Preserved IOD identity, link0/location0/errortype1, threshold and attached-I/O coverage.
Kept IOD and CCD evidence independent.

No target substitution, setting change, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: TXWAFL IOD UCE containment and attached-I/O recovery
test_case.purpose: At each approved IOD TXWAFL endpoint, inject one authoritative UCE, verify the signed containment/reset and fresh IOD-specific durable evidence, and restore the transmit link plus all downstream devices.
required_package: Vendor socket/IOD/TXWAFL topology and link/location mapping
OOB boot/reimage, attached-I/O recovery and exact rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not assume link0 or inject. After approval, bind the exact enumerated link to physical IOD/endpoints, capture raw settings/log baseline, execute one authorized tuple once under OOB capture, correlate fresh IOD evidence and containment/reset, then restore and validate all attached links/devices and bounded I/O integrity.
test_case.expected_result: The intended IOD source emits the approved UCE and containment/reset response; fresh durable fields identify that endpoint; host, TXWAFL link and attached devices recover within limits with clean counters and restored settings.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until severity and tuple semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, generic TXWAFL text, guessed link, wrong/duplicate endpoint, stale record, unexpected reset, missing device, link error or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT with independent OOB and quiesced non-production I/O.
Abort on wrong source/severity, boot failure, persistent AER/link error, device loss or data corruption.
expected_evidence: IOD/TXWAFL/downstream topology and vendor tuple contract
Single injection and OOB containment/reset timeline
test_case.recovery: Cover containment and reset variants, boot/reimage, downstream device/link recovery and exact threshold/BIOS/HDT rollback. Execution remains blocked until approved.
